visualCharacteristics: Grid of game tiles in 2 columns. Each tile has a header image, game title (h3), description, optional draw info, and a CTA button.
contentPattern: Each row is one card. Column 1: game image. Column 2: game title (h3), description paragraph, optional draw info, and CTA button link.
usage: Use for displaying game or product tiles in a structured grid layout with images and call-to-action buttons.
reuseGuidance: Each card row should have a game image in the first cell and text content (title, description, optional details, CTA link) in the second cell.
